providers.pwaAndCdn: Cloudflare Pages for the vendor, partner and admin static exports; Workers/OpenNext for the customer PWA and its same-origin BFF

credentialPolicy: Provider credentials are stored only in provider secret stores or OCI Vault and are never committed.

supersededTargets.objectStorage: Cloudflare R2, superseded by D-15 which approves Supabase Storage; the adapter is implemented, no bucket is provisioned
supersededTargets.pwaAndCdn: Cloudflare Pages for all four PWAs, superseded by D-15 which moves the customer PWA to Workers/OpenNext because a static export cannot serve its BFF routes
